{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_search_named_subpatterns_2.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"mb_ereg_search_init","code":"mb_ereg_search_init('  中国？');","note":"The search API initializes shared regex state from attacker-controlled input before the pattern is applied."},

{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search)","line":0,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg_search forwards the supplied pattern into php_mbregex_compile_pattern and Oniguruma","note":"The attacker-controlled regex pattern reaches Oniguruma's parser and optimizer via mbstring."},
{"step":5,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_search_exec","line":1551,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"MBREX(search_re) = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, option, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax);","note":"Compilation is the key entry point where the vulnerable AST analysis runs inside Oniguruma."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"When the quantified body can match empty, Oniguruma recursively classifies the subtree for memory-node and repeat interactions."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the suspected root cause path from the crash report, matching the reported state names."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4949,"var":"en->te.Then","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(en->te.Then);","note":"Conditional subtrees are also recursively analyzed, increasing the chance of hitting the vulnerable optimizer path with complex patterns."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg_search_getregs)","line":1592,"var":"MBREX(search_regs)","code":"if (MBREX(search_regs) != NULL && Z_TYPE(MBREX(search_str)) == IS_STRING) {","note":"The search result is later read back from the shared region, so any corruption in the regex/search state can surface here."}
]

print('trace updated')
PY
